Name: Automators
Author: Afropenguinn
Description:
This means that chests, stone chests, junimo chests, and hoppers will no longer be automated. Instead, you can now build an Automator to link to nearby machines. The Automator is a mid-late game item made with a Dwarven Gadget, 5 Iridium Bars, and 5 Battery Packs. You learn the recipe for it at Farming level 10.

For any mod that adds a new container, that container will not be able to work with Automate unless you add this mod's data tag to it.
